notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Claws of Gix to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Claws of Gix.
Cast Claws of Gix.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
